title: Company
description:
AhnLab Blockchain Company, a subsidiary of AhnLab, researches blockchain security technology to protect assets and IP in the web3 world. We ensure 
users of all ages and cultures enjoy a safe, convenient web3 experience. We develop and support infrastructure for organizations to adopt blockchain 
wallets and expand their web3 presence.
